title: Grey-block to video (HyperFlow H3 Flash)
description: Turn a grey-block clip and character references into a cinematic shot with HyperFlow H3 Flash on this computer.

controls.label: Direction
controls.default:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit: a grey-block previsualisation clip whose untextured grey shapes stand for the people, props and places of the shot, and whose camera path, lens, framing and timing define the shot.
<Subject 1> is the main character, the person in <Picture 1>, with the same face, hair, body and clothes; in <Video 1> this person is the main grey figure.
<Subject 2> is the further person, prop or location shown in <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>, as each image shows.
summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>: one continuous live-action shot with the camera and blocking of <Video 1>, in which the grey shapes become <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>.
retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (camera, blocking and timing of [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the camera path, lens, framing, timing, the position, size and screen side of every figure and object and each movement are kept exactly; every grey untextured surface is replaced with real people, materials, light and detail.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the face, hair, body and clothes of the person in <Picture 1> are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - each further picture's person, prop or place is retained as its image shows it.
detailed_description:
Live-action, cinematic, photoreal, with natural light, real textures, believable shadows and reflections and slight film grain. [Shot 1] Keep the camera of <Video 1> exactly: its move, lens and angle. There are no cuts, no reframing and no other camera motion. Every grey figure becomes a real person at the same place, size and screen side: the main grey figure becomes <Subject 1>; further grey figures become the people in the other pictures. The grey surroundings become a real place built where <Video 1> has its walls, floor and open space. Faces, wardrobe and props stay consistent for the whole shot.
overall_soundscape:
Natural sound of the scene: footsteps, room tone and ambience that fit the action.
non_diegetic_music:
N/A

evidence: 2026-11-07: The existing Grey-block to video graph retains its video, character and optional picture bindings. The HyperFlow H3 Flash Ref2VA GGUF uses Euler and the six-step HyperFlow schedule.

2026-11-07: A local rooftop grey-block test with a single character reference produced 56 frames at 928 × 512 with generated audio. The result visibly followed the camera movement and used the mascot and rooftop layout.

licenses.software: Adapted from Comfy Org's MiniMax H3 Video Restyling graph. Requires ComfyUI core (GPL-3.0) and the reviewed HyperFlow loader.
